findings.title: Interrupted launch requires an unknown actual-start count
findings.observed: Candidate-001 restricts actual_direct_starts to 0 or 1. Interruption after Popen but before durable callback may leave an intent with no start evidence, so neither exact zero nor exact one is established.
source_support: prototypes/static_tray_v01/supervisor.py: run_process creates the child before invoking on_started
docs/workflow/PROTOCOL.md §8: unknown outcomes must be preserved and reconciled before retry
findings.impact: A forced integer can turn missing evidence into a false zero and undercount an unresolved attempt.
findings.required_resolution: Distinguish exact actual count from retained observed/lower-bound count; represent unresolved actual count as null/UNKNOWN; require positive proof for zero or one; propagate unknown through aggregate counts; block success and automatic retry; preserve initial candidate.

scope: Design only; preliminary source criteria remain separate.
